description: Upstream's viewport code at the pinned commit (tools/goldens/viewport.mjs): getNormalizedZoom, the viewport/scene coordinate transforms, constrainScrollState, getViewportForZoomWithScrollConstraints, AppViewport.translate, zoomToFitBounds, centerScrollOn, scrollBoundsIntoView, getClosestElementBounds, getScrollToContentState, AppWheel.handle event by event and the zoom actions (perform and keyTest), on stand-in Apps. Text measures 10 px per UTF-16 code unit. Non-finite numbers are the strings NaN, Infinity and -Infinity.
